name: Incus
description: Installs Incus from the Zabbly package repository and starts its daemon at every container start in a privileged dev container, so the remote user launches and manages system containers, and optionally virtual machines, inside the container; instances and images persist in a named volume.

channel.description: Zabbly channel to install the newest Incus from: 'stable' (upstream's current feature release) or a long-term support series. An older host kernel may need 'lts-6.0'; see the notes.

vm.description: Install the 'incus' package, which adds virtual machine support with a bundled QEMU, in place of 'incus-base' (containers only). Virtual machines need /dev/kvm from the host.

initialize.description: What the entrypoint does with a daemon that has no storage pool and no managed network: 'minimal' runs 'incus admin init --minimal', 'none' leaves the initialization to you (for example a preseed; see the notes).
